provenance.note: Generic layout from the standard Light service (on / brightness / color-temperature at piids 1/2/3); individual models may add services (colour, modes) or shift ranges - the driver's per-device mapping overrides exist for exactly that.

source: MIoT-Spec standard Light service definition for the light device type, as published in the MIoT specification (miot-spec.org): the device's main service is siid 2.
